raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "asciietch" %}
{% set version = "1.0.6" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/asciietch-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 9cbfb08d7db39adf52fc8ad28ac872cc786c8bba44e97c23567ed63c422d3a27

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  number: 1

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - pytest
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - setuptools >=30
    - tox
  run:
    - future
    - parsedatetime ==2.4
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - setuptools >=30

test:
  imports:
    - asciietch
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/linkedin/asciietch
  summary: A library for graphing charts using ascii characters.
  license: BSD-2-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - thewchan
